w: Swamishri attended the huge Chaitra Punam assembly in the morning.

On addressing the 8,500 strong assembly Swamishri described the single-minded devotion of Premanand Swami towards Shriji Maharaj and the dedication and spiritual conviction of Dada Khachar, Parvatbhai and Shivlal Sheth. Swamishri also emphasised on having a firm faith in Shreeji Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj.
Gems From Swamishri
"One should have three addictions: (a) Sing God’s glory. (b) Do your work or duty. (c) We need food but not by killing something."
"As long as we fail to remove our baser instincts and bad nature, we will keep on suffering unhappiness, frustration and pain."
"Money will not give you happiness. If you have dharma then you have everything."
"When we forget God and misuse science because of our ego then the consequences are pain and misery."
ph: The honor of being with Swamishri, Madhapar

w: Pramukh Swami Maharaj was to leave Sarangpur today. In this context Gnanvijay Swami said, "Today you are leaving, but please always stay in our hearts, so that we do not feel you are far away."
Swamishri said, "Keep remembering us in your heart. We are always together. To believe we are far is itself the mistake."
Hariprakash Swami said, "But the longing for the manifest form still remains, doesn't it!"
Swamishri said, "The longing must remain, but keep your knowledge firm too."

ds.t: The Satpurush neither comes nor goes
w: Pramukh Swami Maharaj was standing before the murti of Shastriji Maharaj, doing darshan. Janmangal Swami, sitting in front, said, "Tomorrow it is Gandhinagar..."
Swamishri immediately said, "Why do you believe like that? To believe this is only ignorance. The Satpurush neither goes nor comes. Even though you are wise, why does this happen?"
Janmangal Swami said, "Where else will we find the joy of you talking to us and moving among us? The joy when you cast your glance is different, isn't it!"

Swamishri said, "Doesn't he who sits here (Shastriji Maharaj), and Shriji Maharaj, see? If there is feeling within, one experiences it. 'Rite jnanan na muktih' (without knowledge there is no liberation). Do you understand? When one has the knowledge of the atma and Paramatma, there is no such thing as far or near."
After a while Janmangal Swami said, "If sometimes we wish to come and benefit from your company, please do not say no."

Swamishri said, "We should act according to God's wish. If it happens, fine, and if it does not, that is fine too. No joy or grief at all. 'The rivers of joy and grief are big, and one gets swept away in them.'"
Janmangal Swami said, "You give nothing but knowledge."
Swamishri said, "When you go to the villages, what do you give people?"
Swamishri had made an argument no one expected, so everyone burst out laughing and Janmangal Swami fell quiet.
Today, addressing Pramukh Swami Maharaj as he was leaving, the speaker Narayanmuni Swami said, "Our request is that either you stay here constantly, or that your murti is seen constantly."
Swamishri said, "It will be seen constantly." Saying this, he remained silent for a while and then said, "If there is devotion in the heart, it is seen constantly."

Since Pramukh Swami Maharaj was about to leave, not a single meeting had been arranged today. But when Swamishri came to know that there was some ill feeling among the three partners of a business firm, he called them himself and met them calmly. Swamishri spoke to them all with encouraging words and kept them together.

Talking to them, Swamishri said, "If we want our business to grow, we should not look at who does more or less, or at this or that. If you work with unity and one mind, it will grow to double what it is now. Work now with the same love with which you worked before."
One of the young men said, "Please make it so that such thoughts do not even arise in the mind."

Swamishri said, "That is true. When living together, sometimes one may have to say something, but take care that no knot forms in the mind. Where there is unity there is both happiness and wealth. Now carry on in the same way. God runs everything and will run it, so do not think, 'I alone do it and the other does nothing.' If we work believing that our affairs belong to God, there will be no problem."

The car was standing near the steps of the mandir. The sadhus were barefoot, and the marble of the mandir's circumambulation path was extremely hot. Pramukh Swami Maharaj must have noticed the movement of the sadhus' feet, because as soon as he came up to the car he said, "All you sadhus stay here. (There is no need to come as far as the Smruti Mandir.) The sun is very strong, so do not follow."
The attendant sadhu said, "Everyone is remembering the Bhogavo."
Hearing this, Swamishri burst out laughing and said nothing, and the sadhus got permission to follow.

In the time of Shastriji Maharaj, Swamishri had gone with him to Wadhwan. Shastriji Maharaj was crossing the bridge over the Bhogavo river at Wadhwan in a horse carriage, and Swamishri, so as to have his darshan every moment, ran barefoot through sand burning like fire in the summer heat. In heat that raised blisters on his feet, he would throw the upper cloth he wore onto the riverbed and stand on it for a while, then run again, put the cloth down again and stand on it for a while. With such supreme devotion Swamishri had the darshan of Shastriji Maharaj. The sadhu had reminded him of this incident.
Swamishri was to leave Sarangpur today. With this in mind Gnanvijay Swami said, "You are leaving today, but stay in our hearts always, so that we do not feel you are far."
Swamishri said, "Keep remembering in your hearts. We are always together. To feel far away is itself the mistake."
Hariprakash Swami said, "But the pull of your physical presence remains!"
Swamishri said, "The pull must remain, but keep the knowledge firm too."

ds.t: The Satpurush neither goes nor comes
w: Swamishri was standing doing darshan before the murti of Shastriji Maharaj. Janmangal Swami, sitting in front, said, "Tomorrow it is Gandhinagar..."
Swamishri said at once, "Why do you think like that? To think like that is ignorance. The Satpurush neither goes nor comes. You are wise, so why does this happen?"
Janmangal Swami said, "Where else will we get the joy of you talking with us? The joy when you cast your glance is different!"

Swamishri said, "Does not this one sitting here (Shastriji Maharaj), and Shriji Maharaj, see us? If there is feeling inside, you experience it. 'Rite jnanan na muktih' (there is no liberation without knowledge). Do you understand? Once knowledge of the soul and God comes, there is no far and near."
After a while Janmangal Swami said, "If sometimes we wish and feel like coming to be with you, please do not say no."
Swamishri said, "We must live by God's wish. If it happens, fine; if it does not happen, fine. No joy or grief at all. The rivers of joy and grief are big; whoever enters them is swept away."
Janmangal Swami said, "You give nothing but knowledge."
Swamishri said, "When you go to the villages, what do you give people?"
Swamishri made an argument so unexpected that everyone burst out laughing and Janmangal Swami fell quiet.

ds.t: The murti will be seen always
w: Today, addressing Swamishri as he was leaving, the speaker Narayanmuni Swami said, "Our request is that either you stay here always, or that your murti is seen always."
Swamishri said, "It will be seen always." Then, after a short silence, he said, "If there is devotion in the heart, it is seen always."

ds.t: Where there is unity there is happiness and wealth
w: Because Swamishri was leaving, not a single meeting had been arranged today. But when Swamishri learned that there was some bad feeling among three partners of a business firm, he called them himself and met them calmly. Swamishri spoke words of strength to them all and kept them together.

Speaking to them, Swamishri said, "If we want to grow the business, do not look at who does more or less, or anything else. If you work with unity and one mind, it will grow to twice what it is. With the same love you worked with before, work now too."
The young man said, "Please make it so that such thoughts do not even come to the mind."

Swamishri said, "That is right. Living together, sometimes things may have to be said, but see that no knot forms in the mind. Where there is unity there is both happiness and wealth. Now carry on just like that. God runs everything and will keep running it, so do not look at it as 'only I do the work and the other does not'. If we work believing that the dealings are God's, there will be no trouble."

The car stood at the steps of the mandir. The sadhus were barefoot, and the marble of the mandir's pradakshina was scorching hot. Swamishri must have noticed the sadhus shifting their feet, so the moment he reached the car he said, "All the sadhus, stay right here. (There is no need to come to the Smruti Mandir.) The sun is very strong, so do not follow behind."
The attendant sadhu said, "Everyone is remembering the Bhogavo."
Hearing this, Swamishri burst out laughing and said nothing, and the sadhus got permission to follow.

In Shastriji Maharaj's time, Swamishri went with him to Wadhwan. Shastriji Maharaj was sitting in a horse carriage crossing the bridge over the Bhogavo river in Wadhwan, and Swamishri, so as to have his darshan every moment, ran barefoot through the summer sand, hot as flames, doing his darshan. In heat that would blister the feet, he would throw his upper cloth on the river bed and stand on it for a while, then run again, put down the cloth again and stand a while. With such supreme devotion Swamishri had darshan of Shastriji Maharaj. This was the memory being recalled.
